learning_outcomes.text: Gaining knowledge in the field of construction and properties of materials depending on the chemical composition, phase and microstructure, as well as acquiring skills and competence in the selection of materials for technical applications.
Has knowledge of engineering materials, their research and shaping technologies.
Is able to select appropriate engineering materials to ensure proper operation of machinery and equipment.
Is ready to complete and critically evaluate specialized knowledge and is able to select sources of knowledge and methods of learning appropriate for himself/herself and others.
Is willing to comprehensively analyze and effectively carry out assigned tasks, and in the event of difficulties in solving them, use expert opinion.

syllabus_topics: Natural and engineering technical materials - comparison of their structure, properties and applications
Elements of crystallography and the basics of solidification
Strengthening of materials, shaping the structure and properties of engineering materials
Heat and thermo-chemical treatment of iron alloys
Working conditions and mechanisms of wear and decohesion of engineering materials
Construction, operation and operation of a metallographic microscope
Analysis of the structure of alloys using phase equilibrium systems
Analysis of the structure and properties of carbon steel and cast steel
Analysis of the structure and properties of cast iron
Analysis of the structure and properties of non-ferrous metals and their alloys
Analysis of the structure and properties of steel and alloys after heat treatment
Qualitative and quantitative assessment of the structure
assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes specified for the course.
